source_row.item_data_json: {"options":{"A":"Ignoring the situation largely, since it doesn't involve them directly, similar to what the witnessing nurse is currently wondering about their role here","B":"Join in with similarly disrespectful behavior, which is not what bystander intervention training actually encourages in this kind of situation","C":"Reporting the incident just if physical assault occurs, which understates when intervention is actually encouraged under this kind of training","D":"Intervene appropriately or support the affected colleague, rather than staying uninvolved as the witnessing nurse is currently wondering about doing"}}
source_row.rationale: Bystander intervention training for workplace incivility encourages witnesses to consider appropriate ways to intervene or provide support, rather than remaining passive observers — this might include directly (and safely) addressing the behavior in the moment, checking in with and supporting the affected colleague afterward, or encouraging and assisting with formal reporting, recognizing that bystanders play an important role in addressing and reducing workplace incivility.
source_row.source_detail: Role of Bystanders in Addressing Incivility
